architecture-review.json.review: One existing Process/Project boundary gains lock-only acquisition. A small persistence helper collects typed original inputs; Projects owns deterministic advisory keys. No new project references, registrations, entities, runtime partials, lock implementation or cycle. The existing UOW and ProjectWriteAdmissionService findings change only in size/source span. The coordinator and Project policy are now required for scoped initial replays as well as new scoped initial commits; composed application already provides both. Lifetime/authority validation remains after duplicate lookup. Root sequence gates follow Projects on the relational path. Actual inherited task publication is still closed.
architecture-review.json.validationStatus: Initial run: 185 of 194 pass; nine Process admission fixture failures retained. All six new initial/root and child/subprocess lock races pass. No production change planned for repair.

final-resource-reconciliation.json.outcome: Initial194 cases executed;185 pass and9 Process admission fixture assertions fail. Six root/subprocess ordering and cancellation races pass. Historical cleanup denials remain unchanged.
